'''Nallen''' was a servant of the Panteer brothers, [[Raal Panteer|Raal]] and [[Heeth Panteer|Heeth]], of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he was working on the [[Panteer estate]] in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], and thus survived the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of Alderaan.
